section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the methodology for assessing body mass index (BMI) in the study. Participants self-reported their height and weight on open-ended items, which were then standardized and used to compute BMI as kg/m². Improbable BMI values (< 12 or > 50 kg/m²) representing less than 4.0% of the dataset were replaced using mean replacement method. The section notes that self-reported height and weight data are strongly correlated with measured data and can be reliably used in population studies.
